Round-1 vote 3 finding [3], re-imported by my own round-1 vote 2 replacement string. ”C förnekar den färg som slutet nämner.” — 'slutet' for a text's closing paragraph is answer-key shorthand no Swedish reader uses. justification: The passage is still convincingly Swedish essä: an object read as evidence, present tense over a vanished practice, plain vocabulary, and three genuinely regional words glossed (schottis, syll, slana), all three of which live in the body in inflected form — 'syllar', 'slanan', 'schottis' — verified by extraction. The dance vocabulary is right for the period the piece describes: vals, schottis, polka, motsols, bjuda upp, spelmän, gammaldans register without pastiche. No translation artefact anywhere, including in the two rebuilt options: 'Den följde parens enkelriktade varv' and 'Den lät paren höra spelmännen' are both native constructions, and 'låta X höra Y' is idiomatic causative Swedish. One new idiom defect from the repair, in the C limb; two carried; one re-imported by my own prescription. Three of round 1's five vote-3 findings are withdrawn. Flag.
